title: America's Biggest Hoaxes (Why Millions Believed)
description:
In 1835, a New York newspaper said bat-people lived on the Moon, and thousands believed it. This animated story follows five American hoaxes, from ghost knocks and a buried giant to fake snake oil, and ends with a twist about the most famous panic of all.

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Why We Fall for Viral Hoaxes
1:19 The Great Moon Hoax of 1835
3:09 The Hydesville Ghost & Spiritualism
4:49 The Cardiff Giant Fake Fossil
6:27 The Rattlesnake King Scam
7:32 The War of the Worlds Radio Panic
8:52 How to Spot Any Hoax Today
